342:t_013:3.en:
$$桂$$
「They're our true enemies... humanity's fundamental calamity...!」

342:t_013:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Watch out! Here they come again!」

342:t_014:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「There are more of them than before...!」

342:t_014:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Damn...! How the hell are we supposed to fight those things!?」

342:t_014:3.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「N-no...! I don't... want to die yet!」

342:t_014:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Is this the end...!? Will we... in a place like this...!?)

342:t_014:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What does it matter! I can still fight!」

342:t_014:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'll do it...! My heart isn't broken yet!」

342:t_016:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What...!? Something is overflowing from my $$スフィア$$...!」

342:t_016:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Wait! I'm guessing you're the one who sent us here too!」

342:t_016:5.en:
???
「$$ズリエル・ジ・アンブレイカブル$$... Your unbreakable will shall open the way...」

342:t_016:6.en:
???
「One day, you will understand everything... Then you will walk the path of $$シンカ$$, and all the universes...」

342:t_019:0.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「...This is the $$インサラウム$$ unit of the $$火星$$ settlers. State your affiliation.」

342:t_019:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$インサラウム$$...! Then this really is... $$火星$$ in our world!」

342:t_019:2.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Could you be... $$クロウ・ブルースト$$?」

342:t_019:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm not someone you need to treat that respectfully, but yes, I'm $$クロウ・ブルースト$$.」

342:t_019:5.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We came here after detecting a $$時空震動$$. What in the world happened?」

342:t_019:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Even if you ask, we can't explain the situation either...」

342:t_019:7.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「You appear to have taken considerable damage. First, let us guide you to our residential area.」

342:t_019:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That would be a big help.」

342:t_019:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They're 《$$インサラウム$$》's 《$$アークセイバー$$》...」

342:t_019:10.en:
$$カレン$$
「I don't really understand... But we... can return to Earth now...」

342:t_019:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm not sure... With things happening one after another like this, I feel another crisis coming...」

342:t_020:1.en:
$n
「Keep it together, $$ＡＧ$$! If the ship goes down, we're finished!」

342:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
(This helplessness... is just like that day $$千鳥$$ was kidnapped and I lost $$アル$$...)

342:t_100:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(But that is precisely why I'll fight...! If I admit defeat here, I'll never be able to fight again!)

342:t_101:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Damn... What the hell is this...!? No matter how often I shake it off, that day keeps rising from the depths of my memory...!)

342:t_101:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
(I stole a child's future... Despair and helplessness make me want to scream...!)

342:t_102:0.en:
$$マオ$$
(I've nearly despaired on the battlefield many times... But this is different even from that...)

342:t_102:1.en:
$$マオ$$
(What in the world is this...? When I try to fight them, I feel like regretting even being alive...!)

342:t_103:0.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
(My heart is being eaten away...)

342:t_103:1.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
(Damn...! It feels like every combat skill I've honed... my very existence... is being denied...!)

342:t_104:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(This helplessness and fear of overwhelming power... are just like that day... when $$シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア$$ took my memories...!)

342:t_104:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(That's exactly why I'll overcome it...! So both I and humanity... can move forward!)

342:t_106:0.en:
$$カレン$$
(I've overcome despair so many times before...! This time too...!)

342:t_106:1.en:
$$カレン$$
(Don't lose, me...! Don't let fear crush you!)

342:t_107:0.en:
$$スザク$$
(I took my father's life... I failed to save $$ユフィ$$... I sold $$ルルーシュ$$ out...)

342:t_107:1.en:
$$スザク$$
(Regret is washing over me... What is that enemy trying to make me do...?)

342:t_107:2.en:
$$スザク$$
(But $$ルルーシュ$$ and I decided...! We'd do what we have to, instead of regretting things...! So...!)

342:t_108:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(Their power is beyond human understanding... Fighting them is like confronting the mysteries of $$パラダイムシティ$$.)

342:t_108:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(But the big difference is that they are enemies blocking our path...! Then I can only confront them as $$ロジャー・スミス$$!)

342:t_109:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
(Their power cannot be resisted... God... fate...)

342:t_109:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
(...But whoever they are, I will not obey...)

342:t_110:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(It's overwhelming power... It's the presence of God...)

342:t_110:1.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(But I turned my back on it and came here... in pursuit of $$キリコ$$!)

342:t_111:0.en:
$$シャッコ$$
(I sense the same presence... as the shadow of the $$異能者$$ I pursued...!)

342:t_111:1.en:
$$シャッコ$$
(Heroes of $$クエント$$...! Lend me the strength to challenge God!)

342:t_112:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(As long as you're there, never giving up the road to peace whatever happens, I can fight...)

342:t_112:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(Even if my enemy is God...!)

342:t_113:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
(Tch...! A self-proclaimed God of Death getting scared is a joke!)

342:t_113:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
(I'll do it, even if I'm only bluffing...! That's how I've lived, and that's how I'll keep living!)

342:t_114:0.en:
$$トロワ$$
(Fear... despair... The feelings I left behind somewhere are welling up endlessly...)

342:t_114:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
(...But I have to keep going... If I stop, I'll only be waiting for them to swallow me.)

342:t_115:0.en:
$$カトル$$
(It's a great will beyond human understanding... Is this... the Heart of Space...?)

342:t_115:1.en:
$$カトル$$
(And it breaks my heart... Destroying a colony, shooting $$トロワ$$... piloting a $$ガンダム$$...)

342:t_115:2.en:
$$カトル$$
(...That's wrong...! This is no Heart of Space...!)

342:t_115:3.en:
$$カトル$$
(Everyone has the will... to move forward, believing in the future...! I know someone who embodies the Heart of Space!)

342:t_116:0.en:
$$五飛$$
(I hesitate, waver, lose my way... That impatience and frustration envelop me...)

342:t_116:1.en:
$$五飛$$
(But I know...! I can't get beyond them unless I struggle...!)
